table: BLS Current Population Survey, annual averages 2025, Table 47: Absences from work of employed full-time wage and salary workers by occupation and industry
how_obtained: www.bls.gov returns HTTP 403 to scripted clients (curl/urllib). The page was read twice through the WebFetch tool with different prompts; both reads returned the same figures. NOT parsed by a script - re-verify by opening the URL in a browser.
coverage_note: Annual estimates for 2025 are 11-month averages that exclude October (not collected due to the federal government shutdown).

definitions.absence_rate: ratio of workers with absences to total full-time wage and salary employment (percent, reference week)
definitions.lost_worktime_rate: hours absent as a percent of hours usually worked
